That the cleaning crew has to visit every toilet ones or twice a day might actually be argued as a good thing...

Here is the real kicker... We are a company of about two thousand people.

No, we buy tons at a time to get it cheap.

You send it to the garbage heap because you need to use the space to store your new paper and soap.
